   "cell_type": "markdown",

   "source": [
    "# Loki2 Cell-level Multiple Instance Learning\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook demonstrates how to train the multiple instance learning (MIL) model on Loki2 cell embeddings for whole slide image classification, and visualize attention weights from trained MIL models."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## MIL Model\n",
    "\n",
    "Prepare training data:\n",
    "- Prepare your data as prampt files by code in `../src/mil/data/data_prepare/prampt_generate` for stage and metastasis task.\n",
    "- Downsample cell embeddings by `../src/mil/data/data_prepare/prampt_downsample.py`.\n",
    "\n",
    "Run MIL to generate attention weights:\n",
    "- Run metastasis task by `../src/mil/models/TCGA-Loki_MILCell_blca_metastasis_5fold.py`.\n",
    "- Run stage task by `../src/mil/models/TCGA-Loki_MILCell_blca_stage_5fold.py`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot Attention Heatmaps on WSI\n",
    "\n",
    "Generate spatial heatmaps showing model attention across whole slide images. MIL models use attention mechanisms to identify which cells/regions are most important for classification decisions. This interpretability feature helps understand what morphological features drive predictions for tasks like cancer staging and metastasis prediction."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The example data is stored in the directory `../data/mil`, which can be donwloaded from [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19qzd8jTZBQ57a3N5xbiZFSGZJNpIz8NQ?usp=sharing).\n",
    "\n",
    "You will need:\n",
    "- Attention weight files from MIL models\n",
    "- Whole slide images for visualization"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "import loki2.plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Parameters\n",
    "max_dim = 4096  # Maximum side length for thumbnail\n",
    "point_size = 3  # Scatter point size\n",
    "alpha = 0.6  # Transparency\n",
    "cmap = \"rainbow\"  # Colormap"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### TCGA BLCA Stage Subtype MIL Results\n",
    "\n",
    "Visualize attention weights from MIL models trained for cancer staging classification. This helps identify morphologically distinct regions that are predictive of tumor stage."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Configure SVS file paths and attention file paths\n",
    "slide_dict_stage = {\n",
    "    \"TCGA-2F-A9KW\": \"../data/mil/TCGA-2F-A9KW-01Z-00-DX1.CECFDA2E-2CE7-4115-B4E6-A3D75B130232.svs\",\n",
    "    \"TCGA-4Z-AA80\": \"../data/mil/TCGA-4Z-AA80-01Z-00-DX1.303549D2-42A5-46C4-AD9D-D72337B416E5.svs\",\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "attention_weights_stage = {\n",
    "    \"TCGA-2F-A9KW\": \"../data/mil/stage_attention.txt\",\n",
    "    \"TCGA-4Z-AA80\": \"../data/mil/stage_attention.txt\",\n",
    "}"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[PLOT] TCGA-2F-A9KW\n",
      "[SAVED] ../outputs/mil/output/stage/attention_heatmap_TCGA-2F-A9KW.png\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 768x613.875 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[PLOT] TCGA-4Z-AA80\n",
      "[SAVED] ../outputs/mil/output/stage/attention_heatmap_TCGA-4Z-AA80.png\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 768x766.688 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n",
      "✅ All attention heatmaps processed!\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "out_dir = Path(\"../outputs/mil/output/stage/\")\n",
    "os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "save_images = True  # If True → save PNG; if False → only display\n",
    "\n",
    "for case_id, svs_path in slide_dict_stage.items():\n",
    "    att_txt = attention_weights_stage.get(case_id)\n",
    "    if att_txt is None:\n",
    "        print(f\"[SKIP] No attention file for {case_id}\")\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    out_png = out_dir / f\"attention_heatmap_{case_id}.png\" if save_images else None\n",
    "    print(f\"[PLOT] {case_id}\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    loki2.plot.plot_attention_on_slide(\n",
    "        svs_path=svs_path,\n",
    "        att_txt=att_txt,\n",
    "        case_prefix=case_id,\n",
    "        save_path=out_png,\n",
    "        max_dim=max_dim,\n",
    "        point_size=point_size,\n",
    "        alpha=alpha,\n",
    "        cmap=cmap,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n✅ All attention heatmaps processed!\")"
   ]
  },
